状语从句拓展:although / even if / in case: 让步、退一步的假设、以防万一——这三个连接词让你的句子有"弹性"。
although / though "虽然",不能与 but 连用|even if "即使",退一步假设|in case "以防万一",动作是为了预防|so that "以便"(表目的)|no matter how / however "无论多么" + 形容词或副词
Although it was late, we kept walking.
column3: 虽然天晚了,我们还是继续走。

状语从句拓展:although / even if / in case: Even if it rains, the match will go on.
column3: 即使下雨,比赛也会继续。

状语从句拓展:although / even if / in case: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
He spoke slowly so that we could follow.
column3: 他说得慢,好让我们跟上。

状语从句拓展:although / even if / in case: However tired you are, keep going.

# title: ___ he is rich, he lives simply.
I will not give up ___ I fail again.
column4: 即使再失败,退让假设用 even if。

# title: She left early ___ she could catch the ferry.
column4: 表目的"以便赶上渡船",用 so that。
后接形容词 hard,"无论多难"用 however。

# title: Although the task was difficult, ___ we finished it.
column4: although 不与 but 连用,可用 yet。
